retrievalProfile.description: A vintage 1960s soul album aesthetic featuring a male-female duet in vibrant attire against a natural tree-trunk background with high-contrast, multi-colored display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man and woman standing close together in front of a large, textured tree trunk. The man wears a bright orange-red suit, and the woman wears a vibrant blue dress. The composition is framed by dense foliage, with bold, colorful text layered across the top and sides.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject contrast between bright orange and cyan-blue clothing
Textural contrast between smooth fabric and rough tree bark
Symmetrical placement of text blocks flanking the central subjects
High-saturation color palette against a dark, natural background
coreInvariants: Vibrant orange-red and cyan-blue primary subject colors
Rough vertical tree bark texture as a central divider
Bold, condensed sans-serif main title in bright red

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures in a medium-close shot, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The textured tree trunk positioned between the two subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red title at the top, moves down to the subjects' faces, then outward to the secondary text blocks on the left and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense foliage in the upper corners and dark shadows within the tree bark.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep greens and browns of the natural background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright cyan-blue and vibrant orange-red of the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and cyan used for secondary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements against a lower-value, textured background.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses heavy, ultra-condensed block capitals
Secondary titles use a mix of casual, rounded script and geometric sans-serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, condensed sans-serif with a soft, casual script.

preserve: Condensed proportions of the main title
Vibrant color coding for different text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the main title.
Captures the mid-century casual script aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a bright orange suit and a woman in a cyan dress standing in front of a large tree trunk in a wooded area, 1960s film style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, red, ultra-condensed sans-serif title at the top. Add magenta script subtitles and cyan sans-serif tracklists on the left and right sides.

verificationChecks: Is the main title red and ultra-condensed?
Are the subjects wearing orange and cyan?
Is the background a textured tree trunk?
Is the overall color saturation high?

mustAchieve: Authentic 1960s film grain and color saturation
Balanced typographic layout flanking the subjects
Clear separation between foreground subjects and background texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red title is the most prominent element.
Verify the orange and blue clothing colors are vibrant.
Check that the tree bark texture is visible between the subjects.
Confirm the secondary text is legible against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation duet portrait with a central vertical anchor and a three-color typographic hierarchy using condensed and script faces.
